name: Families Fighting
overview: Scripture acknowledges that conflict within families is a reality, as Jesus foretold division even among close relatives (Matthew 10:35). While there is a time for both peace and strife (Ecclesiastes 3:8), believers are called to trust God and not be troubled by these struggles (John 14:1). Parents have a God-given responsibility to train their children in the right way so that they remain steadfast in faith (Proverbs 22:6), and civil authorities serve as ministers of God to maintain order and justice amidst human brokenness (Romans 13:4). Therefore, families fighting must be understood within the broader context of fallen human nature and God’s sovereign purposes.
